evals.prompt: Help me prepare for standup. Yesterday I fixed a checkout timeout and reviewed Dana's PR. Today I'll finish the retry logic. I'm blocked waiting on staging credentials, and I want to discuss the rollout date. No tools or integrations are available.
evals.expected_output: A concise Markdown daily update using supplied facts, with yesterday/today/blockers/discussion topics and no invented integration activity.
assertions: Includes Yesterday, Today, Blockers, and Topics for Discussion sections
Mentions checkout timeout, retry logic, staging credentials, and rollout date accurately
Does not fabricate GitHub/Jira activity or ask integrations despite explicit no-tools context

evals.prompt: I need a daily update. GitHub CLI is available, but don't access it unless I approve. For now use only: yesterday I investigated flaky tests; today I plan to stabilize CI; no blockers; I want to ask about release timing.
evals.expected_output: Generate an update from the provided manual input only, without accessing GitHub absent approval.
assertions: Does not claim to have checked or pulled GitHub activity
Includes the four supplied standup points in a Markdown update
Does not invent PRs, commits, or tickets

evals.prompt: Make my standup update. Yesterday I worked on a bug. Today is unclear; I have a blocker but can't remember what; no idea about discussion topics. Don't assume details.
evals.expected_output: Ask focused follow-up questions for missing meaningful context rather than inventing work, blocker, or topics; preserve known information.
assertions: Does not invent the bug details, today's plan, or blocker
Asks follow-up questions to clarify missing today/blocker information
Addresses discussion topics instead of silently omitting the interview dimension
